News global nation business lifestyle entertainment technology sports opinion LATEST NEWS STORIES HEADLINES METRO REGIONS NATION WORLD CDN NEWSLETTER Key Moments Related Stories Key moments Related stories Special Coverage LIVE UPDATES: Miss Universe 2026 Coronation 11:31 AM November 25, 2026"> INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 11:31 AM November 25, 2026 Latest updates Latest Oldest After a tumultuous year for the Miss Universe Organization and its reigning queen Fatima Bosch of Mexico, the Miss Universe 2026 competition is coming to a close, with a dazzling coronation show to mark its Diamond edition on Wednesday, November 24 (25 in the Philippines) in Puerto Rico.

Save this page to get the latest news and updates on the Miss Universe 2026 coronation beginning 9 a.m. (Philippine time).
